d: Nureddin. Abul Hassan Ali Ebn Bekar
Margiana. Then Bostana. Then the Kadi. Then four servants. Finally three Muezzin behind the scene.
Margiana. Nureddin. Abul in front of the window

Nureddin. Margiana. Abul in front of the window Nureddin and Margiana still listen for some time, if no new noise arises. Everything remains silent, Nureddin leads Margiana to the seat at the flower table and kneels on the stool at her feet.
